title: Stop Lifting Weights Like An Amateur
hook: Stop lifting weights like an amateur if you want real muscle growth.

scenes.text: Stop lifting weights like an amateur if you want real muscle growth.
scenes.visual_prompt: intense muscular athlete chalking hands before a heavy deadlift, dark gritty gym, cinematic volumetric rim lighting

scenes.text: Most people fail because they change their workout routine every single week chasing soreness.
scenes.visual_prompt: stacks of rusted heavy iron dumbbell plates in dimly lit underground weight room, dramatic shadows

scenes.text: Your muscles do not care about variety. They respond strictly to mechanical tension and progressive overload.
scenes.visual_prompt: anatomical muscular human physique glowing with red electric power and energy, hyperrealistic medical 3d render

scenes.text: Pick three compound movements, master perfect form, and force your body to lift heavier every single month.
scenes.visual_prompt: loaded heavy Olympic barbell bending under extreme weight on squat rack, spotlight reflection

scenes.text: Discipline will build ten times more muscle than temporary motivation ever could. What is your current bench press?
scenes.visual_prompt: lone disciplined warrior standing in pouring rain, calm focused facial expression, cinematic epic shot

cta: What is your current bench press? Comment below.
